statement: The actual second cusp period generically cannot lift holomorphically to a finite Hopf modification with nonempty elliptic-axis centre or a finite cycle of marked modifications. More generally a preserved elliptic cap axis of nonzero normal degree d admits translation b only if d b=0.
depends_on: A.1.2; B.4.8; B.4.10; identity principle and elliptic Picard translation
notes: Root and boundary_d independently checked the finite-modification proof; D supplied the normal-line strengthening. The marked axis and holomorphic action must extend. Infinite disjoint-copy shifting has the wrong punctured core; connected noncompact unfoldings and central-only caps remain open. No meromorphic-to-holomorphic comparison is assumed.
